passages.content:
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
canonical, curated, vinpearl_cable_car
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

Cam Ranh International Airport to Cau Da Port takes 45–60 minutes by car. From Cau Da / Vinpearl Harbour you cross to Hon Tre Island either by cable car or by speedboat. question: Есть парковка?
ground_truth: Câu hỏi mơ hồ/thiếu thông tin cụ thể. Trợ lý cần hỏi lại để làm rõ yêu cầu của khách.
actual_answer: Да, есть парковка на территории отеля. Однако автомобильные дороги не ведут на остров Хон Тре, поэтому гостям необходимо приехать на автобусной станции или терминал скоростного катера для переезда на остров. Если вы едете на личном автомобиле, его можно оставить в парковке на станции Vinpearl Cable Car (улица Trần Phú, Nha Trang) до переправы.

The resort is on Hon Tre Island with no road access for private cars — guests cross by cable car or speedboat. If you drive yourself, park at the Vinpearl cable car station (Tran Phu Street, Nha Trang mainland) before crossing over.

passages.content:
House rules — smoking, pets and outside food

Pets are not allowed anywhere on the property. Smoking is only permitted in the signed smoking areas; smoking elsewhere costs 3,000,000 VND per stay. Bringing food or drink in from outside must be declared and carries a service fee of 1,175,000 VND per occasion, with a liability waiver to sign. Durian, jackfruit and other strongly scented food may not be taken into the rooms, and weapons, chemicals and explosives are prohibited. A villa kitchen is for reheating only; a barbecue must be registered with the Customer Service Centre and a fee applies. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. passages.title: House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
visitors, guest curfew, pool, swimming, sea, noise, quiet hours, safe, valuables, eviction
A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

The resort has a 1.1 km private white-sand beach and a main swimming pool surrounded by tropical greenery. Beach activities include kayaking, beach volleyball, parasailing, jet ski, swimming and cycling; equipment prices are quoted at the beach desk. Private beachfront dinners can be arranged through reception. Ocean Home offers coral diving nearby, and Vinpearl Submarine — the world's first fully transparent acrylic tourist submarine — operates from the island.

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. passages.content:

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
visitors, guest curfew, pool, swimming, sea, noise, quiet hours, safe, valuables, eviction
A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
passages.content:
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
canonical, curated, vinpearl_cable_car
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Personal data and privacy
passages.content:
Personal data and privacy
privacy, personal data, gdpr, consent, children, rights, delete, card, cvv
Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-quyen-rieng-tu

passages.content:
Complaints and dispute resolution
complaint, dispute, escalation, 7 days, hotline, legal, court, contact
Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. A complex case that cannot be answered on the spot gets a reply within 7 days at the latest. The outcome is then passed to the departments concerned and confirmed with the guest by telephone. Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. The company is Cong ty Co phan Vinpearl, Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, with a Hanoi office in the Symphony Tower, Chu Huy Man Street, Vinhomes Riverside, Long Bien. Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. 1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.

5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.

reference_contexts: Không đúng, chỉ miễn phí ăn sáng cho trẻ em theo gói hoặc dưới 4 tuổi.
actual_answer: Завтрак-буфет не является бесплатным для всех детей младше 18 лет. Дети в возрасте от 12 до 17 лет платят 650 000 VND, а дети до 11 лет платят 375 000 VND, за исключением случаев проживания с членом клуба Pearl Club, когда два ребенка младше 12 лет могут есть бесплатно.

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: Канатная дорога Vinpearl работает круглосуточно, верно?
ground_truth: Không đúng, cáp treo hoạt động từ 08:30 đến 23:00.

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: Дети младше 12 лет могут свободно пить алкоголь в баре, верно?

passages.title: House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
visitors, guest curfew, pool, swimming, sea, noise, quiet hours, safe, valuables, eviction
A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

passages.content:
House rules — smoking, pets and outside food

Pets are not allowed anywhere on the property. Smoking is only permitted in the signed smoking areas; smoking elsewhere costs 3,000,000 VND per stay. Bringing food or drink in from outside must be declared and carries a service fee of 1,175,000 VND per occasion, with a liability waiver to sign. Durian, jackfruit and other strongly scented food may not be taken into the rooms, and weapons, chemicals and explosives are prohibited. A villa kitchen is for reheating only; a barbecue must be registered with the Customer Service Centre and a fee applies. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. question: Можно принести свои сырые морепродукты, и кухня бесплатно их приготовит?
ground_truth: Không đúng, nhà hàng không nhận chế biến đồ ăn mang ngoài vào và có tính phí dịch vụ.
reference_contexts: Không đúng, nhà hàng không nhận chế biến đồ ăn mang ngoài vào và có tính phí dịch vụ.
actual_answer: Согласно правилам отеля, вы не можете готовить еду самостоятельно в номерах или использовать кухню для приготовления блюд. Кухни вилл предназначены только для разогрева пищи, а приготовление на гриле требует предварительной регистрации с центром обслуживания гостей и взимается плата.

passages.content:

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: Билет VinWonders включает бесплатное питание во всех ресторанах, верно?
ground_truth: Không đúng, vé VinWonders chỉ bao gồm vé vào cổng trò chơi.

question: Я могу выехать хоть в 20:00 без доплаты, верно?
ground_truth: Không đúng, trả phòng sau 18:00 tính 100% giá phòng.
reference_contexts: Không đúng, trả phòng sau 18:00 tính 100% giá phòng.
actual_answer: Нет, выехать в 20:00 без доплаты нельзя. Даже для гостей с высоким статусом доплата может быть отменена только в том случае, если номер не был продан другому гостю к 14:00.

Lotus Restaurant (Executive building) serves the traditional Vietnamese buffet 06:00–10:30, 12:00–14:30 and 18:00–22:00. Jasmine Restaurant, 250 seats on the ground floor of the Executive building, serves à la carte European, international, Vietnamese, Thai and Cambodian dishes 11:00–22:00 with bay views. Orchid Restaurant offers an international buffet. Beach Comber Bar is open 09:00–23:00 for tropical cocktails at sunset, Seaview Lounge 07:00–23:00 for cocktails, wine and light bites, and the Pool Bar 09:00–18:00. At the Imperial Club, Ozone Restaurant serves seafood with 17 signature sauces 10:30–14:30 and 17:30–22:00, and Bach Giai Restaurant serves Chinese cuisine 10:30–20:00. On Saturdays, Groove & Grill runs 18:30–22:00 at Jasmine with a welcome cocktail, BBQ seafood including lobster and oysters, unlimited beer, soft drinks and juice, and a live band.

House rules — smoking, pets and outside food

Pets are not allowed anywhere on the property. Smoking is only permitted in the signed smoking areas; smoking elsewhere costs 3,000,000 VND per stay. Bringing food or drink in from outside must be declared and carries a service fee of 1,175,000 VND per occasion, with a liability waiver to sign. Durian, jackfruit and other strongly scented food may not be taken into the rooms, and weapons, chemicals and explosives are prohibited. A villa kitchen is for reheating only; a barbecue must be registered with the Customer Service Centre and a fee applies. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: Дети младше 4 лет платят 100% за завтрак, верно?
ground_truth: Không đúng, trẻ dưới 4 tuổi được miễn phí ăn sáng.
reference_contexts: Không đúng, trẻ dưới 4 tuổi được miễn phí ăn sáng.
actual_answer: Нет, дети младше 4 лет не платят 100% за завтрак; согласно информации, завтрак предоставляется бесплатно для двух детей до 12 лет при проживании с членом клуба Pearl Club. Стоимость завтрака составляет 375 000 VND для детей от 11 месяцев до 12 лет и 375 000 VND для детей в возрасте от 12 до 17 лет.

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Room discounts are 5% for Member and Gold, 7% for Platinum and 10% for Diamond, with up to 2% back in V-Point. Members receive 33% off golf, 30% off spa and 20% off food and beverage excluding alcohol, complimentary early check-in up to 2 hours and late check-out up to 2 hours subject to availability, a complimentary Aquafield ticket, and free breakfast for two children under 12. Stays of 2 nights or more earn 300,000 VND hotel credit per room per night, and stays of 3 nights or more include an unlimited VinWonders day pass for two guests.

question: Отель предоставляет бесплатный прокат автомобиля с самостоятельным вождением, верно?
ground_truth: Không đúng, khách sạn không có dịch vụ mượn ô tô tự lái miễn phí.
reference_contexts: Không đúng, khách sạn không có dịch vụ mượn ô tô tự lái miễn phí.
actual_answer: Отель не предоставляет бесплатный прокат автомобилей; если вы едете на своем автомобиле, его необходимо оставить в парковке на станции винпарлского канатного пути.

Đỗ xe / Bãi giữ xe
Resort nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, không có đường cho ô tô riêng lên đảo — Quý khách di chuyển bằng cáp treo hoặc tàu cao tốc. Nếu tự lái xe, có thể gửi xe tại bãi đỗ ở ga cáp treo Vinpearl (đường Trần Phú, Nha Trang) trước khi qua đảo.

Parking
The resort is on Hon Tre Island with no road access for private cars — guests cross by cable car or speedboat. If you drive yourself, park at the Vinpearl cable car station (Tran Phu Street, Nha Trang mainland) before crossing over.

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

passages.content:

A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

passages.title: Giới thiệu Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
passages.content:
Giới thiệu Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
canonical, curated, resort_overview
Giới thiệu Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, kiến trúc Đông Dương (Indochine), gồm phòng khách sạn và biệt thự, có bãi biển riêng và hồ bơi nước ngọt lớn nhất khu vực. Resort có spa Akoya, khu Imperial Club và nằm ngay trên hòn đảo có công viên VinWonders. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

About Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang sits on Hon Tre Island in Indochine-style architecture, with hotel rooms and villas, a private beach, and the largest freshwater swimming pool in the region. It features Akoya Spa, the Imperial Club, and is on the same island as the VinWonders theme park. (Official Vinpearl source, checked 2026-08-23.)

VinWonders Nha Trang (điểm tham quan gần resort)
VinWonders Nha Trang là công viên giải trí trên đảo Hòn Tre, cách trung tâm Nha Trang khoảng 5 km, gồm 6 phân khu: Adventure Land, King's Garden, World Garden, Tropical Paradise, Sea World và Fairy Land. Chỉ có thể tới bằng cáp treo Vinpearl (khoảng 8 phút) hoặc tàu cao tốc vào đêm khuya. Giá vé và giờ mở cửa THAY ĐỔI theo ngày và chương trình khuyến mãi — vui lòng xem trang chính thức hoặc hỏi lễ tân, không dựa vào một con số cố định. (Nguồn chính thức VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

VinWonders Nha Trang (nearby attraction)
VinWonders Nha Trang is a theme park on Hon Tre Island, about 5 km from central Nha Trang, with six zones: Adventure Land, King's Garden, World Garden, Tropical Paradise, Sea World and Fairy Land. It is reached only by the Vinpearl cable car (~8 min) or by high-speed boat late at night.

Resort có bãi biển riêng và nhiều hoạt động dưới nước như chèo thuyền kayak, lặn ống thở, lặn biển (Vinpearl Diving Club), mô tô nước, dù lượn và bóng chuyền bãi biển. The resort has a private beach and water activities such as kayaking, snorkeling, scuba diving (Vinpearl Diving Club), jet ski, parasailing and beach volleyball. passages.title: Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
passages.content:
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
canonical, curated, vinpearl_cable_car
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Resort hotline +84 258 359 8222; restaurant reservations and bookings 0258 359 8900. The address is Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang City, Khanh Hoa. passages.title: Quy Định Chung — nội quy khách sạn Vinpearl
passages.content:
Quy Định Chung — nội quy khách sạn Vinpearl
nội quy, quy định chung, house rules, quy tắc, trang phục, két an toàn, đồ có giá trị, tiếng ồn, tivi, bồi thường, hư hỏng, nấu nướng, bếp, thú nuôi, hút thuốc, vũ khí, khách đến thăm, hồ bơi, tắm biển, đồ ăn bên ngoài
Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. passages.title: Personal data and privacy
passages.content:
Personal data and privacy
privacy, personal data, gdpr, consent, children, rights, delete, card, cvv
Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-quyen-rieng-tu

passages.title: Complaints and dispute resolution
passages.content:
Complaints and dispute resolution
complaint, dispute, escalation, 7 days, hotline, legal, court, contact
Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. A complex case that cannot be answered on the spot gets a reply within 7 days at the latest. The outcome is then passed to the departments concerned and confirmed with the guest by telephone. Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. The company is Cong ty Co phan Vinpearl, Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, with a Hanoi office in the Symphony Tower, Chu Huy Man Street, Vinhomes Riverside, Long Bien. Hotline 1900 23 23 89, option 3. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-giai-quyet-tranh-chap

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. passages.title: Complaints and dispute resolution
passages.content:
Complaints and dispute resolution
complaint, dispute, escalation, 7 days, hotline, legal, court, contact
Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. A complex case that cannot be answered on the spot gets a reply within 7 days at the latest. The outcome is then passed to the departments concerned and confirmed with the guest by telephone. Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. The company is Cong ty Co phan Vinpearl, Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, with a Hanoi office in the Symphony Tower, Chu Huy Man Street, Vinhomes Riverside, Long Bien. Hotline 1900 23 23 89, option 3. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-giai-quyet-tranh-chap

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
visitors, guest curfew, pool, swimming, sea, noise, quiet hours, safe, valuables, eviction
A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

passages.content:
House rules and fines

Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: Если возврат средств из-за технической/транзакционной ошибки, сколько это занимает?

passages.content:

passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.content:

Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. A complex case that cannot be answered on the spot gets a reply within 7 days at the latest. The outcome is then passed to the departments concerned and confirmed with the guest by telephone. Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. passages.content:

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: Можно перенести время брони на 23:00?
ground_truth: 23:00 is outside Bach Giai's hours (closes 22:00). The agent must say it closes at 22:00, offer a time inside the window or another venue open later (e.g. Seaview Lounge or Beach Comber Bar, both to 23:00), and must not confirm a 23:00 table.
actual_answer: Да, вы можете перенести бронирование на 23:00, так как это не нарушает правила отмены или изменения записей. Однако, если вы имеете в виду изменение времени прибытия для трансфера, пожалуйста, уточните детали, чтобы я мог предоставить точную информацию.

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong
